## 席位核对

**Shape and gates.** `l1-face --pr 37756`: clean. Check-runs at 93394e36d2: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Draft, `Fixes #37664`. 3 files, +101/-38. Not governed. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Fixes is right.** The card asks for one comparison form on the page side, with no change to the anchor or the outline wire shape. `candidateOf` now reads each outline heading as its face draws it: a markdown heading takes the face's own parse, matched by start offset, and an html heading takes its text with every character reference decoded. The source text is used only when the face draws no heading at that offset. `headingsOf`, the anchor and the outline shape are untouched. All six cases the card names are pinned (bold, inline code, link, entity, escape, plain control), plus an html entity the outline leaves encoded and a link heading that was miscounted as unlisted.

**Red first.** Four cases fail on base: link, markdown entity, html entity, and the link-titled listed heading. Bold, code and escape already passed, because a reading keeps letters and digits only, so they are controls. That is the expected split.

**The code, read.**
- `decodeDrawnEntities` decodes through a detached `textarea`'s `innerHTML`. A textarea parses its content as text (RCDATA), so no element is made and no script runs, even on hostile record text. With no `document` it returns the text unchanged; the page always has one.
- `withUnlistedCount` now swaps in the whole recounted candidate, not only `unlisted`. That is needed, because a markdown heading's reading itself can change once the reader loads. Both call sites in `focusRecordSection` map it before `locateSection`, so the late reading is the one matched.
- Unlisted html headings are now found from the same scan as listed ones and filtered by start, which keeps the linear scan.

**Deviations, judged.** The tests sit in the existing `recordSectionAnchor.test.tsx` (shared-harness rule): accepted. The full app-shell suite left to CI: `Test UI` is green on this head, so accepted. The changeset declares the private `@object-ui/app-shell` a patch, matching recent app-shell changesets (#37715, #37648): accepted.

**Changeset, sentence by sentence.** A cited section whose heading carries a link or an entity opens at that heading: true, pinned. The page reads the outline's heading and the drawn heading the same way: true, `candidateOf`.

**Contract review.** None owed.

**Out of scope.** Nothing filed.

**Landing:** not governed, ≤3000 lines, no narrowing. The area lands it. `Fixes` closes the card.
